newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian barracks collapse, killing at least three.
newsitem.headline: Russian barracks collapse, killing at least three.

text.p: Three people died, dozens were injured and some trapped under rubble on Thursday when ceilings collapsed in a dormitory at a military school in western Siberia, an Emergencies Ministry spokeswoman said.

"Two people can be heard from under the rubble. The fate of another eight people is unknown," she said by telephone, adding that 42 people had been taken to hospital, and 10 of them were in a serious condition.
Interfax news agency quoted a regional assembly official as saying earlier that at least three people were alive under the rubble and were answering rescuers' questions.
About 120 people, most of them cadets, were in the three-storey building of the Tomsk Military Communications School when roofs caved in five minutes before the wake-up call.
A special investigation and rescue team headed by Emergencies Minister Sergei Shoigu has set off for the site.
The spokeswoman said the building had once been a monastery and was converted to a dormitory in the early 1950s. Then a third storey has been constructed on top of two existing ones.
